fields: L6 Hong Kong / Mid-Autumn Festival (inline roller skates; Central → Victoria Harbour → The Peak). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4 / L5. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 月饼摊 Mooncake Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh must equal choices; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12 where CJK=1, ASCII=0.5), peak_final = The Peak / 太平山顶 final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational, no bare arithmetic). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Peak final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 中秋谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L5 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: 过节时挂起来的纸灯，英文叫____。
questions.explain_en: That festival lamp is a lantern.
questions.explain_zh: 这种节日灯叫 lantern（灯笼）。
questions.qtype_zh: 词义（同义/反义/押韵/词义）

questions.subject: safety
questions.q_en: A string of lanterns hangs low across the Peak path. Flora should ____.
questions.q_zh: 一串灯笼低低地挂在太平山路上。Flora 应该____。
choices: close her eyes and roll on
jump as high as she can
questions.explain_en: Duck under low lanterns; do not jump into them.
questions.explain_zh: 灯笼挂得低，要蹲下通过，不要跳进灯串里。

questions.subject: hongkong
questions.q_en: From the Peak at night, the shining stretch of water below Flora is ____.
questions.q_zh: 夜里从太平山向下看，Flora 眼前那片发亮的水是____。
questions.explain_en: The harbour lies below the Peak.
questions.qtype_zh: 香港地标（中环/维港/太平山）

questions.subject: midautumn
questions.q_en: At the Peak lookout, Auntie holds out a warm round pastry for Flora and Bara. What is it?
questions.q_zh: 在太平山观景台，阿嫲向 Flora 和 Bara 递出一块热乎乎的圆形点心。那是什么？
questions.explain_en: Auntie shares a mooncake at the Peak.
questions.explain_zh: 阿嫲在山顶把月饼递给她们。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the Peak, Auntie stacks 2 warm mooncakes on the left tray and 3 on the right tray. How many mooncakes does she stack?
questions.q_zh: 在太平山，阿嫲左边托盘放了 2 块热月饼，右边放了 3 块，她一共放了几块？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 9 warm mooncakes sit at the Peak lookout. Auntie hands out 6 of them. How many mooncakes are still on the tray?
questions.q_zh: 太平山观景台放着 9 块热月饼，阿嫲送出了 6 块，托盘上还剩几块？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the harbour, 16 red lanterns and 8 gold lanterns hang for Mid-Autumn. How many more red lanterns than gold ones are there?
questions.q_zh: 维港为中秋挂了 16 盏红灯笼和 8 盏金灯笼，红灯笼比金灯笼多几盏？
questions.qtype_zh: 比较相差（多多少/高多少）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the Peak, Flora counts 7 trays of 10 mooncakes and 8 single mooncakes. How many mooncakes is that?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在太平山数到 7 盘月饼（每盘 10 块）和 8 块单独的月饼，一共多少块？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Trams lining up by the harbour are numbered 11, 15, 19 in a pattern. What number is on the next tram?
questions.q_zh: 维港边排队的叮叮车按规律编号：11、15、19，下一辆叮叮车是几号？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the Peak, Flora opens her pouch and finds 2 five-yuan notes and 3 one-yuan coins to buy mooncakes. How many yuan are inside?
questions.q_zh: 在太平山，Flora 打开零钱袋，看到 2 张五元和 3 个一元硬币要买月饼，里面一共多少元？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora sees 5 pentagon-shaped tags on a tram by the harbour. How many sides do they have altogether?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在维港的叮叮车上看见 5 面五边形的旗子，它们一共有几条边？
